## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Section Two Permits

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A01
The unlicensed start with a permit before any drive test, and that permit itself takes five ordered steps: application, documents, fee, knowledge tests, vision test [A01].
Why it matters: group permit-path; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F01, sec02-F08, sec02-F09, sec02-F10 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A01
Four proofs do four jobs: identity says who you are, two residency proofs say you live in California, the name document bridges mismatched names, and the social security number identifies the record [A01].
Why it matters: group application-proofs; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F02, sec02-F03, sec02-F04, sec02-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A01
The permit demands two test passes, knowledge and vision, while documents and fees are paperwork rather than tests [A01].
Why it matters: group permit-path; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F09, sec02-F10 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A02
Driver education is the program minors must complete, while driver training is the in-car instruction whose instructor validates the permit [A02].
Why it matters: group teen-requirements; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec02-F13, sec02-F15, sec02-F22 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A02
Practice supervisors split by age: eighteen-plus suffices for adults, but minors need a twenty-five-plus licensed driver [A02].
Why it matters: group supervision; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F18 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A02
The teen ladder runs fifteen-and-a-half for the permit, sixteen for the license, a six-month permit hold, and fifty practice hours with ten at night [A02].
Why it matters: group teen-requirements; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec02-F12, sec02-F20, sec02-F21, sec02-F23 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A03
Three bans bind every provisional driver: no late-night driving, no young passengers without a qualified rider, and no paid or commercial driving [A03].
Why it matters: group provisional-bans; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F26, sec02-F27, sec02-F28 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A03
Four exceptions need four different signers: physician for medical need, principal or dean for school, employer for work, and parent or guardian for family [A03].
Why it matters: group exceptions; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec02-F29, sec02-F30, sec02-F31, sec02-F32 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A03
The provisional word marks the teen license, and the same parents behind it can cancel it outright with the surrender form [A03].
Why it matters: group provisional-bans; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F25, sec02-F33 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]
